verdict.rationale: Typesense is driven through a documented public REST API. The vendor says the complete API surface ships in the open-source server and Cloud offers 'Full API Access', API reference pages exist (e.g. /docs/latest/api/curation.html), and community users independently describe the REST interface and its filter_by/sort_by query syntax. The MCP server and llms.txt add further agent-friendly entry points. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found at the probed paths, and the evidence shows little of the API reference's depth beyond a single page.
